verdict.rationale: Amazon SES documents automation-like features, such as receipt rules that trigger Lambda, SNS or S3 actions, and event publishing via configuration sets. So asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes versioning, change review, revision history or rollback for any of these, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
